titulo: Microsoft refreshes its smaller Surface Pro and Laptop with Qualcomm’s X2 Plus
cuerpo: Microsoft is refreshing its Surface Pro 12-inch and Surface Laptop 13-inch devices with Qualcomm's latest Snapdragon X2 Plus chips. The smaller Surface devices retain the same design and hardware features from last year, with faster and more capable chips inside and higher price tags (thanks RAMageddon!).
